definition: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre

definition: a unit of distance equal to one thousand metres

definition: a small unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

definition: a unit of weight equal to one thousand grams

definition: a unit for measuring the amount of a liquid

definition: a unit used to measure temperature or angles

definition: how wide something is from side to side

definition: how tall something is from bottom to top

definition: how heavy something is

definition: the space between two places

definition: how fast something moves

definition: the amount of space inside something or occupied by it

definition: how hot or cold something is

definition: a device used to measure how heavy something is
